title: Soil moisture at twelve plots
description: Volumetric soil water content and soil temperature at 10 cm depth on twelve invented meadow plots, read by hand probe on two days in summer 2024. Every plot and reading is invented.

archive:spatialCoverage.description: Twelve plots in one invented meadow.

archive:methods: A handheld capacitance probe was pushed to 10 cm at the centre of each plot; each value is the mean of three readings taken within one metre.
